title: Rollout lifecycle evacuation and tenant triage bridge
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an operational bridge and runbook that coordinates fast evacuation (soft-failover, tenant fencing, and model variant fallback) for model rollout regressions that surface in Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments. This ticket captures the end-to-end choreography: detection, triage, immediate mitigations, cross-team responsibilities, automated rollback triggers, and customer communication templates. The goal is to reduce mean time to safe-state for customer-impacting regressions to under 12 minutes for P0 regressions and ensure no tenant is left without a clear remediation path in mixed deployments.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Playbook documents step-by-step detection -> triage -> mitigation for Hosted/Dedicated/Private with clear ownership.
2) Automated canary circuit triggers for model quality/latency regressions (thresholds defined) are implemented.
3) Automated rollback or staged fallback can be executed via runbook CLI with < 3 manual steps.
4) KV cache drain + reconciliation checklist included for variant switches.
5) Customer communication templates (field liaison, status page, postmortem) checked into Drive and linked.
6) A cross-env tabletop run completed and findings recorded.
detection_triggers: Quality regressions: canary eval delta > 7% F1 or semantic-accuracy drop; Latency regressions: p95 > SLO + 150ms sustained for 5 minutes; Error rates: >0.5% 5xx or model-timeout spikes; Customer signals: support escalation or anomalous tenant metrics. Triggers integrate with existing runtime alerts and Redwood Console incident dashboards.
immediate_mitigation: 1) Open incident channel (#inc-rl-rollouts). 2) On-call triage confirms signal source (model variant vs infra vs prompt). 3) If model-variant suspected, enact staged fallback: redirect 20% -> safe-variant, ramp to 100% if metrics improve. 4) If KV cache poisoning or stale cache suspected, run tenant-specific KV drain + rehydrate script. 5) If Dedicated/Private: trigger tenant-fencing (isolate affected tenant slice) and activate Dedicated patch pool. 6) Notify Field Liaison to prepare customer comms.
coordination_matrix: Hosted: central control plane can flip routes; automated fallback preferred. Dedicated: coordinate with customer reserved capacity owner and solutions engineer — use canary slice routing to avoid tenant impact. Private (VPC/on-prem): require playbook steps that can be executed by customer operator or via out-of-band upgrade tool; include pre-approved RBAC-runbook tokens for emergency rollbacks. All flows list primary and fallback owners: Oncall (first 10 minutes), SRE (mitigation scripts), Release Manager (rollback decision), PM (customer comms), Field Liaison (customer-facing updates), Security (if data residency/keys involved).
rollback_runbook:
- Preconditions: snapshot model config, tag current variant, capture KV cache checkpoint.
- Step 1: Pause new rollout traffic using deployment gate.
- Step 2: For Hosted, invoke route-switch API: revert to previous verified variant; for Dedicated, patch pool assignment to previous model image; for Private, provide operator rollback script and remote guidance.
- Step 3: Drain KV cache per-tenant where necessary and rehydrate from checkpoint.
- Step 4: Monitor canary metrics for 10 minutes; if green, gradually restore traffic to original routing with attention to sequence lengths.
- Step 5: Create a hotfix PR for the defective model or config and link to incident.
- Escalation criteria: if rollback fails or metrics worsen, engage executive on-call and prepare emergency-scoped hotpatch.
kvcache_reconciliation: Checklist: identify impacted tenants -> run kvcache-inspect to list stale segments -> run kvcache-drain --tenant <id> -> validate rehydration via synthetic prompts from golden prompt set -> reconcile mismatched entries by re-seeding from origin model prompts. Document edge cases: cross-tenant shared cache shards, KV encryption key rotations in Private deployments (coordinate with security).
communication_plan: Tiered templates: 1) Immediate ack to customer (Field Liaison): brief summary, mitigation in progress, ETA for next update. 2) 30-min update: technical summary, scope (tenants affected), mitigation steps, expected impact. 3) Post-rollback: root cause summary, mitigation taken, timeline, and next steps. 4) Postmortem: full write-up with corrective actions, owner assignments, and retro. Templates checked into Drive under /Incidents/Rollout-Bridge/Templates.
postmortem_tasks:
- Attach incident timeline and logs to ticket.
- Add regression test to canary suite covering the failing prompt set.
- Create automation to run KV reconciliation when variant switch occurs.
- Update Console dashboards to alert on the specific semantic metric that failed.
- Track PR for model fix and verify with a staging deployment.
- Schedule 1-week follow-up runbook refinements and tabletop exercise.
